actions.description: Remove repartition(1)/coalesce(1) or repartition by the table's partition key
actions.rationale: a single task writes all output; partitioning keeps parallelism
actions.validation: re-run the job; stage task count > 1 in the event log

actions.description: If one output file is required, write partitioned then merge in a separate compaction step
actions.validation: event log shows parallel write stage; file count matches expectation

prerequisites: confirm downstream consumers do not require a single file
risks: more, smaller output files if partitioning is not reviewed
rollback_notes: re-add the repartition call if consumers regress

remediations.problem: cartesian join explodes rows and skews partitions

actions.description: Replace crossJoin with a keyed join or broadcast the smaller side
actions.expected_effect: bounded shuffle size, no skewed single partition
actions.validation: event log shuffle bytes and task skew drop

prerequisites: confirm the join semantics are truly cartesian
validation_steps: diff row counts and sample output
rollback_notes: revert join change if results differ

remediations.problem: global sort forces a single-partition ordering

actions.description: Replace orderBy with sortWithinPartitions, or sort after a selective filter
actions.rationale: global sort requires one partition for total ordering

prerequisites: confirm downstream does not need total order
rollback_notes: restore orderBy if total order is contractual

remediations.problem: collect() pulls the full dataset to the driver

actions.description: Replace collect() with take(n)/bounded collect, or write to storage and read back
actions.rationale: driver memory is bounded; unbounded collect risks OOM
actions.validation: driver OOM errors absent; job completes

risks: consumers expecting full data get a sample
validation_steps: verify all rows still consumed downstream
rollback_notes: restore collect behind a size guard

actions.description: Call unpersist() after the last use of the cached DataFrame
actions.rationale: cached blocks hold executor memory until evicted
actions.validation: storage memory drops in the event log

risks: unpersisting too early recomputes the lineage
validation_steps: confirm no stage re-reads the source
